newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI says AMP largest shareholder.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI says AMP largest shareholder.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Monday its largest identifiable shareholder was the AMP Society with a five percent stake after its former parent, ICI Plc sold down its majority stake.
Asked who the company's major shareholder was now, ICI Australia managing director Philip Weickhardt told reporters: "we believe AMP is probably the largest with five percent.

Weickhardt said at this stage it was impossible to identify whether there was one or more individual shareholders that may have had a higher stake than AMP because the largest shareholdings were held within nominee companies.
As a result of the public offer of ICI Plc's stake, ICI Australia has added 50,000 new shareholders to its register taking the total number of shareholders to about 70,000, Weickhardt said.
Weickhardt said it was likely the underwriters to the issue would take up their over allotment option depending on market conditions.
The institutional price for the ICI Plc shares was A$12.35 per share, while the retail price was A$11.95 per share.
ICI Plc offered 143 million shares, most of its 62.4 percent in ICI Australia.
